key.name: tile-grid
key.summary: Tile all windows on this workspace into a grid
key.description: Arrange every ordinary window on the active workspace and current monitor into an even grid — four windows become four quarters. Stock mutter can only tile a single window to a half.

key.name: command-center
key.description: Open one dashboard per workspace, full screen and without browser chrome, and switch back to workspace one. Press again to close them all. The four URLs come from kldload-command-center, which resolves them out of Grafana at the moment the key is pressed rather than hardcoding a dashboard that may have been renamed.
